bra: Every brief carries the store-name rule, a store-neutral rule and a product-specific claim ban (no AI species recognition, two-way audio, IP66, cloud, memory card, battery life; `the app`, never an app name) — the compliance layer is there from the first round.

Page facts hold (read live from the product page 2026-09-24): 5 MP camera, solar panel on the roof, transparent food ball, water cup by the perch, instructions in the box, green colour, `du vet att de äter – bara inte vilka`.

TR_1_1 (`Den känner inte igen fågeln åt dig.`) is a limitation no AI-recognition competitor can sign — the strongest hook in the round; CO_1_H1 makes the plain feeder the enemy with the page's own line.
UG_1_H1 says in Rules that it is a demo performance, not a testimonial — no fake review.
Price 1 659 / 2 159 / 500 kr right in all 15.
missat: No VARIABELTAGGAR, no Memo, no `AI content:` line, no COPY CARD and no shot-level direction table — the brief format since 2026-09-21 (docs/os/BRIEF-REGI.md, `CS-KLART` 2.9/2.12); written 2026-09-19/20 so the direction table is a note, not an error, this once.

Account-level claims without a number: `the price-anchor angle is the strongest-performing angle across the whole ad account` (CS_4_H1, CS_5_1), `gift is the second-strongest per spend` (GT_1_H1) — name the ad, its CPA, purchases and break-even, or write "guess".

Fifteen briefs on a product with no data — `CS-KLART` punkt 8: the number of briefs never exceeds the number of lessons the team can write. Seven with a static twin each would have been the same test at half the cost.
The same hook opens two briefs (`Ingen ström att dra ut i trädgården.` in BOF_2_1 and OB_1_H1) without either saying `Isolated variable: format` — the data will not know they are a pair.

PD_4_H1's hook `Fågeln hann försvinna. Kameran hann inte.` reads as the camera failing to keep up; the meaning intended is that the camera caught it. Read the Swedish back before it is burned into captions.
The three-question table is ✅✅❌ Pass on all ~75 lines, including `Se när det är dags att fylla på.` and `Beställ fågelmataren.` — filled in, not run.
This product has no memory in the repo — the Feedback row in the hub is its memory until a products entry exists.
regler: Every brief carries the 2026-09-21 format: VARIABELTAGGAR, `Memo:`, `AI content:`, COPY CARD and, for video, one direction row per script line (Audio · On-screen text · Picture · Effect · Source · Latitude).
A claim about the account (`strongest angle`, `second-strongest`) names the ad, its CPA, purchases and break-even in the same sentence — or is written as "guess".

One hook belongs to one brief: a static and a video that share a hook are declared a pair with `Isolated variable: format`; and every hook is read aloud in Swedish before it goes out — `Kameran hann inte` says the opposite of what it means.
